name: Kat Invaders
description: A unique Space Invaders clone featuring a kawaii Japanese cat-girl pilot defending Earth from invading alien pets! Features progressive difficulty, power-ups, boss battles, combo system, and procedural kawaii pixel art. Built with the WebGameFramework.
author: little-coder
features: Power-up drops (rapid fire, double shot, shield, mega laser, smart bomb, extra life)
Boss battles every 5 levels with minions
